# Validate inputs
    if not (isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray) and isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) and isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray)):
        raise ValueError("All log probability matrices must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_no_call.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_with_result.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if not (logp_no_call.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_with_result.shape):
        raise ValueError("All log probability matrices must have the same shape")
    if 0 in logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("Matrices must not be empty")
    if np.any(np.isnan(logp_no_call)) or np.any(np.isinf(logp_no_call)) or \
       np.any(np.isnan(logp_call_only)) or np.any(np.isinf(logp_call_only)) or \
       np.any(np.isnan(logp_with_result)) or np.any(np.isinf(logp_with_result)):
        raise ValueError("All log probabilities must be finite")
    if np.any(logp_no_call > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_with_result > 0):
        raise ValueError("Log probabilities must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
    if np.isnan(tau_filter) or np.isinf(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_no_call.shape
    offsets = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * offsets)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)
    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    return keep, margin

def filter_api_calls(empty_log_probs, call_only_log_probs, call_with_result_log_probs, tau_filter):
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(empty_log_probs, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(call_only_log_probs, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(call_with_result_log_probs, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("All log probability matrices must be numpy arrays")
    if empty_log_probs.ndim != 2 or call_only_log_probs.ndim != 2 or call_with_result_log_probs.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Log probability inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if empty_log_probs.shape != call_only_log_probs.shape or empty_log_probs.shape != call_with_result_log_probs.shape:
        raise ValueError("All log probability matrices must have the same shape")
    n_candidates, future_horizon = empty_log_probs.shape
    if future_horizon == 0:
        raise ValueError("future_horizon must be at least 1")
    if np.any(np.isnan(empty_log_probs)) or np.any(np.isinf(empty_log_probs)) or \
       np.any(np.isnan(call_only_log_probs)) or np.any(np.isinf(call_only_log_probs)) or \
       np.any(np.isnan(call_with_result_log_probs)) or np.any(np.isinf(call_with_result_log_probs)):
        raise ValueError("All log probabilities must be finite")
    if np.any(empty_log_probs > 0) or np.any(call_only_log_probs > 0) or np.any(call_with_result_log_probs > 0):
        raise ValueError("Log probabilities must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
    if np.isnan(tau_filter) or np.isinf(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")
    
    # Compute weights
    offsets = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * offsets)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum
    
    # Compute weighted future-token loss for each candidate
    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * call_with_result_log_probs, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(normalized_weights * empty_log_probs, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * call_only_log_probs, axis=1)
    
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    
    # Margin
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    
    # Keep if margin >= tau_filter
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    
    return keep, margin"}
